name: TwinCover Commercial COPE
description: Commercial property underwriting walk-through capturing Construction, Occupancy, Protection, and Exposures.

items.label: Exterior Elevations & Construction Class
items.promptHint: Snap front/side walls to confirm brick, masonry, steel, or wood frame and adjoining exposures.

items.label: Roof Surface, Age & Drainage
items.promptHint: Capture roof membrane/shingles, scuppers, or ask owner for roof replacement year.

items.label: Main Electrical Panel & Amperage
items.promptHint: Open panel door; capture main breaker amperage (e.g. 200A) and manufacturer label.

items.label: Fire Protection & Sprinkler Riser
items.promptHint: Snap sprinkler riser gauge/tag, fire extinguishers, or ULC central-station fire alarm panel.

items.label: HVAC, Heating & Plumbing
items.promptHint: Capture furnace/rooftop unit nameplate or mechanical room piping.

items.label: Life Safety, Exits & Security Controls
items.promptHint: Snap illuminated exit signs, panic bars, deadbolts, CCTV, or burglar alarm keypad.

items.label: Housekeeping, Occupancy & Peak Stock (TIV)
items.promptHint: Snap main floor/stock & speak approximate square footage and peak inventory value ($).
